SELECT w_state, i_item_sk AS i_item_id, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN d_date < '2001-05-02' THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN d_date >= '2001-05-02' THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after 
FROM catalog_sales 
LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns 
  ON (cs_order_number = cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk) 
JOIN warehouse 
  ON catalog_sales.cs_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk 
JOIN (SELECT i_item_sk, i_current_price 
      FROM item 
      WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49) AS filtered_item 
  ON filtered_item.i_item_sk = catalog_sales.cs_item_sk 
JOIN date_dim 
  ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
WHERE date_dim.d_date BETWEEN '2001-04-02' AND '2001-06-01' 
GROUP BY w_state, i_item_sk 
ORDER BY w_state, i_item_sk 
LIMIT 100
